    Description

    Provides connections to the application's configured PostgreSQL database.
    dbSetup

    Represents an employee with identity, account, position, and discipline-point data.

    Provides database operations for retrieving and modifying employee records and credentials.
    EmployeeFormController
    Manages the employee form for adding, editing, and deleting employee records.

    Model for how much each employee sold in the sales report

    Configures and manages the employee table and employee add/edit forms.

    Controller for the manager to view and update the inventory
    InventoryController.UsageDateRange
     
    InventoryController.UsageTimeRange
     
    InventoryDAO
    Handles the database queries for the inventory
    InventoryItem
    Model for an item in the inventory
    Item
    Model for an item on the menu
    ItemDAO
    Performs database reads and writes for menu items, recipes, and modifications.
    LoginController
    Handles employee sign-in and opens the main application view after successful authentication.
    Main
    Starts the POS system app
    MainController
    Controls the main application view, navigation, employee display, and logout flow.
    ManagerController
    Controls manager-page navigation by loading manager views into the content area.
    MenuEditorController
    Coordinates the manager interface for viewing and editing menu drinks.
    MenuItemFormController
    Manages the menu-item form, including menu item details and recipe ingredients.
    Mod
    Represents a priced modification, such as a topping, available for an item.
    Order
    Immutable summary of a completed customer order.
    OrderDAO
    Reads order history and reports, and persists orders with their items, modifications, and related inventory deductions.
    OrderFilters
    Optional criteria used to search and count orders.
    OrderHistoryController
    Controls the manager's searchable, paginated order-history table.
    OrderHistoryController.PageResult
    Result returned by a page-loading task.
    OrderItem
    Immutable details for one menu-item line within a customer order.
    PaymentMethodSales
    Aggregated sales totals for a payment method.
    RecipeIngredient
    Represents an inventory item and the quantity of it used in a recipe.
    SalesReportController
    Controller for the manager to generate sales reports over a date range
    SalesReportData
    Aggregated data used to display a sales report.
    SalesReportRow
    Sales and estimated cost summary for one menu item.
    SalesTrendRow
    Sales revenue recorded for a single calendar date.
    XReportController
    Configures and refreshes the manager's date-selectable hourly X-report.
    XReportDAO
    Reads hourly sales aggregates used to build the manager's X-report.
    XReportRow
    Aggregated X-report sales and payment totals for one hour of a reporting day.
